title: Settings of the responsive images check (RB-093-02): Settings > Checks > Responsive images

oversizeFactor.description: An image file with more than this many times the pixels its rendered size needs at the view's density is too large (1.1 to 10).

undersizeFactor.description: An image file with less than this many times the pixels its rendered size needs at the view's density is too small and looks blurred (0.1 to 1).

checkLcp.description: Check that the page's Largest Contentful Paint image loads eagerly and with fetchpriority="high".
